scopeNotes: Kana and kanji orthographic variants map to the same lexical target. Suru nouns and predictable polite forms map to their dictionary headword; the corpus is not padded with duplicate forms.

Word lists and grammar libraries sometimes sequence the same basic word differently. Basic lexical senses are retained when supported by the N5 reference inventory; advanced grammar is not inferred from a vocabulary label.

Polite noun prefixes, weekday abbreviations, counters and numeric compositions map to their actual learning examples. Advanced clause patterns are explicitly deferred rather than counted as N5 coverage.
Legacy devices (e.g. tape recorder), register variants (家内/わたくし), and proper names are labelled/retained for recognition; they are not called a modern official syllabus.
